headline: Record profitability as ITW raises full-year guidance
summary_short: Illinois Tool Works posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $4.301 billion (+6.1% y/y) and its most profitable quarter ever with operating margin of 26.7%, GAAP EPS of $2.84 (+10.1% y/y), and raised full-year 2026 guidance on both revenue growth and EPS.
summary_long: Revenue rose 6.1% y/y to $4.301 billion, with organic growth accelerating to 4.5% led by North America (+6.4%) and double-digit organic gains in Welding and Test & Measurement and Electronics. Operating income grew 7.4% to $1.147 billion, the most profitable quarter in company history, as operating margin expanded 40bps to 26.7% on 120bps of enterprise-initiative gains, partially offset by price/cost timing lags. GAAP EPS rose 10.1% to $2.84. Free cash flow was $631 million (+41% y/y, 77% of net income). ITW returned $1.2 billion to shareholders via dividends and $750 million of buybacks. Full-year 2026 guidance raised: organic growth to 3-4%, GAAP EPS to $11.35-$11.55.

drivers.explanation: Organic growth accelerated to 4.5%, led by 6.4% North America growth with double-digit gains in Welding and Test & Measurement and Electronics; currency translation added 1.4pts and an acquisition added 0.2pts.

Enterprise initiatives contributed 120bps to margin expansion to 26.7%; price increases more than offset higher raw-material costs in dollar terms, though inflation/price timing lags modestly diluted margins.
EPS growth tracked the operating-income and margin gains described above; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles was a $0.04 per-share drag on GAAP EPS this quarter.
Citing strong operational momentum, ITW raised FY2026 guidance: organic growth range lifted to 3-4%, revenue growth to 4-5%, and GAAP EPS raised $0.15 to a narrowed $11.35-$11.55 range.
